# Gate 3 report

*Generated by `tools/gate3_report.py`. Regenerate after any change to the censoring map or to `censor.py`. This file is written, never edited.*

Measured on `t9v2_1M_seed20250.parquet`, 1,000,000 rows, 55 master columns.

## The four views

The views are MASKS over one master, never copies: same rows, same order, same temporal split. Only visibility differs, which is what makes C1 to C4 an ablation rather than four experiments.

| View | Layers | Columns | Masked on lost rows | Dropped | Funnel cells visible |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **C1** | DSP only | 29 | 8 | 26 | 299,733 |
| **C2** | DSP + MMP | 29 | 0 | 26 | 1,000,000 |
| **C3** | DSP + SSP | 31 | 8 | 24 | 299,733 |
| **C4** | DSP + MMP + SSP | 31 | 0 | 24 | 1,000,000 |

## What each layer adds

| Contrast | Adds | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| C1 to C2 | **rows** | the same 29 columns, funnel labels on every row instead of the 299,733 won rows only. 700,267 lost rows gained per funnel column |
| C1 to C3 | **columns** | `bid_density`, `winning_price` |
| C2 to C4 | **columns** | the same 2, on top of full attribution |
| C3 to C4 | **rows** | the same row gain, on top of price visibility |

## Gate 3 pass conditions

| Result | Condition | Measured |
|---|---|---|
| PASS | `click` reads won, all, won, all | won, all, won, all |
| PASS | every latent hidden in all 4 views | 24 latent columns, 0 exposed |
| PASS | `user_id` hidden everywhere | absent from all 4 |
| PASS | C4 sees at least C2, C2 at least C1 | columns and visible cells both nest, on all 4 edges |

## The three kinds of absence stay distinguishable

Collapsing any pair of these would change what a model trained on the view learns, so each is counted rather than assumed.

| Meaning | Encoding | Count in C1's `click_timestamp` |
|---|---|---:|
| you were not told | `NA` | 700,267 |
| told it did not happen | `-1` | 292,301 |
| told it happened | a timestamp | 7,432 |

Masked integer columns keep an integral dtype (`Int8` on `click`), so a count never silently becomes a measurement.

## A defect found at the start of stage 3

`H3` (`won`) was derived as a funnel outcome, which would have hidden it on lost rows in C1 and C3. Specification 1.5 lists it under "Always visible: A, B, `C`, D, H1, H2, H3", and both reasons matter. Real: every DSP is told whether its own bid won, whatever data layers it buys, because that is the bid response and not attribution. Structural: **Tier 2 learns P(win | bid) from this column**, so C1 and C3 would have had no losses to learn from, and those are the 2 views the SSP result is measured across.

`build_graph.py` now excludes it from the funnel rule, `graph.yaml` changed by 2 lines, and the always-visible group went from 20 columns to 21.

## Gate 3 verdict

**PASS**
